# Vendored kernel provenance

Source: https://github.com/brendanjmeade/Bem2d.jl

Commit: `e5a33e0291d0c090d0a7c46c866a2f1217f9d653`.

`src/Bem2d.jl` and `LICENSE` are unchanged copies. `Project.toml` is a minimal
dependency subset for the archived static example, not the upstream's full
FEM/notebook/plotting environment. The dynamic Python engine does not depend
on this kernel.
